summary: 호환 admission은 fence 0을 유지하고 작업 attempt fence로 CAS하며, public-operation v2만 admission과 attempt fence를 동일하게 강제한다.
invariants: workspace operation attempt token and fence remain exact for all pointer writes
public-operation v2 admission fence must equal the workspace attempt fence
forbidden: treating a compatible fence-0 admission as public-operation v2
